verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an email product, but the evidence shows no self-hostable Fastmail app or way to run its mail pipeline on your own infrastructure. The JMAP material (an open standard that lists reference server and client implementations) and the bare 'Open source and standards' page title are protocol-level building blocks, not a Fastmail self-hosting capability. Community comments about fetching via Gmail or using Fastmail SMTP describe a hosted service, not user-controlled infrastructure.
